<title level="1" right="Spell 4" pfs="Standard">
[Mountain Resilience](/Spells.aspx?ID=1610)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Earth" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=55" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 346

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

**Deities**
[Arqueros](/Deities.aspx?ID=244), [Dammerich](/Deities.aspx?ID=117), [Imbrex](/Deities.aspx?ID=94), [Irori](/Deities.aspx?ID=286), [Kazutal](/Deities.aspx?ID=41), [Keepers of the Hearth](/Deities.aspx?ID=248), [Sairazul](/Deities.aspx?ID=107), [Soralyon](/Deities.aspx?ID=128), [Trudd](/Deities.aspx?ID=91)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** touch

**Target** 1 creature
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 20 minutes
</row>

</column>

---

The target's skin hardens like the stone of a mountain face. It gains resistance 5 to physical damage, except [adamantine](/Equipment.aspx?ID=374). Each time the target is hit by a bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing attack, _mountain resilience's_ duration decreases by 1 minute. 

---
**Heightened (6th)** The resistance increases to 10.

**Heightened (8th)** The resistance increases to 15.

**Heightened (10th)** The resistance increases to 20.
name: Mountain Resilience
